api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('fixmatch')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, weak_logits, strong_logits, threshold=0.95, unlabeled_weight=1.0, reduction='mean', ignore_index=None)
description: FixMatch objective combining labeled cross-entropy with confidence-masked pseudo-label cross-entropy on strong-view logits; hard pseudo-labels come from detached weak-view logits and the unlabeled term is averaged across the full unlabeled batch.

examples.title: Train a classifier with FixMatch

name: FixMatch loss

parameters.ignore_index: optional integer target value ignored in the supervised labeled term (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating point labeled class logits with shape [B_l, C]
parameters.reduction: none returns concatenated labeled and unlabeled per-example losses; mean averages each branch by its own denominator; sum adds all losses (default mean)
parameters.strong_logits: required floating point logits for strongly augmented unlabeled examples with shape [B_u, C]
parameters.targets: long tensor of labeled class indices with shape [B_l]
parameters.threshold: finite real confidence threshold in [0, 1], accepted when maximum weak-view probability is greater than or equal to it (default 0.95)
parameters.unlabeled_weight: finite nonnegative weight for the confidence-masked unlabeled loss (default 1.0)
parameters.weak_logits: required floating point logits for weakly augmented unlabeled examples with shape [B_u, C]
